depends_on: J. Singer (1938): lines of PG(2,q) are (q^2+q+1, q+1, 1) difference sets (for the closed form at n = 3^m only)
notes: First conjecture proved in Lean (Mathlib + OpenProblemsLib.Dwork): A210456_three_dvd (3 | a(n) for n >= 2, a(n) = least period of the n-step Fibonacci numbers mod 9), with exists_period / a210456_spec (pure periodicity, a(n) is the least period). The Lean route replaces Gauss's trace congruence by Dwork's lemma: the power sums ps(m) are the coefficients of N/P (P = 1 - x - ... - x^n, N = -theta P), exp(sum ps(m) x^m/m) = 1/P is integral, so 9 | ps(9t) - ps(3t); every period of the sequence mod 9 is a period of ps; ps(3) - ps(1) is 3 or 6. Outside Lean: Helenius's closed forms a(3^m - 1) and a(3^m), i.e. the mod-3 periods (generation of F_{q^2}^*, Hilbert 90 and Singer difference sets) and a = 3P, argued in the README and checked by PARI for m <= 6.
